text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm... So everyone loves delicious<n>food, yes?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
O-okay... how do you feel about a<n>sweet treat? Like
whipped cream<n>with strawberries and peaches on
top?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Creek, she said it doesn't sound bad.<n>That means
we're in the clear for a<n>birthday cake!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's good news. I already<n>have the
ingredients, so I can make it<n>right away. ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Great, we'll knock it out of the park!<n>Just you wait,
Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Are ya tryin' to sneakily tease out<n>what I want or
not?!
